column1: # The classes of the zero-bail acceptance (tools/engine_core/zero_bail.py, docs/ZEROBAIL_RESUME.md).
# Every counted cause of a dual report (`<label> [bail|gate: <why>]`) is listed here by the FIRST row whose label and why match (Python
# regular expressions, whole-string match). A cause no row matches is "unclassified" and fails the step in enforce mode: a new cause is
# never hidden, somebody must read it and write a row.
# Columns (tab separated; lines starting with # are comments):
#   class     census   the dual counts a body of the STRING driver (a step arm, a reconcile hook, a turn-end hook) that the core runs
#                      natively as a job or window of its own; nothing stopped, and the string result stands because the dual is an
#                      observer for that body. Native evidence: the live arm and its lockstep tests.
#             adapter  a lent WINDOW the dual's adapter declines (a guard written before the native path existed: it has no ability
#                      registry, no host for the card, no kernel hook for the faction rule); the native path plays the position and a
#                      lockstep test (string against native) or a core test pins it.
#             gap      a REAL gap of the native path (a position a game can reach that the core does not play). Fails in enforce mode.
#   label     regex over the window label (`d1::step`, `tactical::activate`, ...)
#   why       regex over the reason (`tactical`, `Scanlink Drone Network held`, `nested (unported ability ...)`; a gate keeps the text after `gate: `)
#   reason    one sentence: why this is not a stop of a whole native game
#   evidence  `path::token` items separated by ` ; `: the file must exist and contain the token (zero_bail.py --verify-evidence, and the
#             test tools/engine_core/test_zero_bail.py, check them, so a renamed test or a deleted native function breaks the build)
# What proves "a whole game plays natively with zero bails" is NOT this table: it is the native evidence zero_bail.py reads in the same
# step (native_play zero gaps on 96 + 288 games, and the bench results: every game a victory, no problem, 6 x 200 games on the native wrapper).
# This table says why the dual's own counters are not that evidence.
